description: This file implements a SOAP API server for SuiteCRM, providing various methods for user authentication, entity retrieval, creation, updates, relationship management, and miscellaneous utility functions. It handles SOAP registration, validation, and core operations for interacting with CRM entities such as users, contacts, notes, modules, and relationships.

classes.name: NoteSoap
classes.description: Class responsible for handling note attachments, including saving files and retrieving file contents.

classes.name: SoapError
classes.description: Class responsible for handling SOAP error states and formatting error responses.

methods.name: is_user_admin
methods.description: Checks if the current user associated with the session has administrative privileges.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user and initiates a session, returning a session ID on success.

methods.name: is_loopback
methods.description: Checks if the SOAP server and client are running on the same machine.

methods.name: validate_authenticated
methods.description: Validates session ID, starts session handling, and loads the current user.

methods.name: seamless_login
methods.description: Performs internal authentication for seamless background login, used during sync.

methods.name: get_entry_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries from a specified module based on query parameters.

methods.name: get_entry
methods.description: Retrieves a single entry by ID from a specified module.

methods.name: get_entries
methods.description: Retrieves multiple entries by a list of IDs from a specified module.

methods.name: set_entry
methods.description: Creates or updates a single bean record in a specified module.

methods.name: set_entries
methods.description: Creates or updates multiple bean records in a specified module.

methods.name: set_note_attachment
methods.description: Adds or replaces an attachment on a note.

methods.name: get_note_attachment
methods.description: Retrieves an attachment from a note.

methods.name: relate_note_to_module
methods.description: Associates a note with a specific module entity.

methods.name: get_related_notes
methods.description: Retrieves notes related to a specific module entity.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Ends the session and logs out the user.

methods.name: get_module_fields
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about fields of a specified module.

methods.name: get_available_modules
methods.description: Returns a list of modules available to the logged-in user.

methods.name: update_portal_user
methods.description: Updates contact properties for portal user functionality.

methods.name: get_user_id
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the current session.

methods.name: get_user_team_id
methods.description: Returns the default team ID for the user.

methods.name: get_user_team_set_id
methods.description: Returns the team set ID for the current user.

methods.name: get_server_time
methods.description: Returns the current server date/time.

methods.name: get_gmt_time
methods.description: Returns the current GMT date/time.

methods.name: get_sugar_flavor
methods.description: Returns the flavor/version of SugarCRM in use.

methods.name: get_server_version
methods.description: Returns the current SugarCRM server version.

methods.name: get_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves relationships of a record with other modules/entities.

methods.name: set_relationship
methods.description: Creates a relationship between two beans/entities.

methods.name: set_relationships
methods.description: Creates multiple relationships between pairs of beans/entities.

methods.name: handle_set_relationship
methods.description: Internal method to establish a relationship between two beans, called by set_relationships.

methods.name: set_document_revision
methods.description: Saves a new document revision as part of document management.

methods.name: search_by_module
methods.description: Performs a full-text search within specified modules and returns matching records with specified fields.

methods.name: get_mailmerge_document
methods.description: Generates a mail merge document as HTML, encoding it in base64, based on a cached merge array file, handling parsing of fields and related module data, and compiling an HTML table.

methods.name: get_mailmerge_document2
methods.description: Similar to get_mailmerge_document, but with extended handling for multienum and currency types, returning HTML, name-value list, and error info.

methods.name: get_document_revision
methods.description: Retrieves a document revision by ID, returning its content encoded in base64 along with metadata, after validating the session.

methods.name: set_campaign_merge
methods.description: Logs targets of a mail merge under a campaign ID for tracking, validating session before proceeding.

methods.name: get_entries_count
methods.description: Counts records in a given module matching optional query and deletion status, with session validation and access checks.

methods.name: set_entries_details
methods.description: Creates or updates multiple records in a module based on provided name-value lists, returning IDs and errors.

methods.name: handle_set_entries
methods.description: Internal function to process a batch of records for creation/updating, with duplicate checking, ACL and permission validation, and support for special module handling like Contacts and Meetings.
